caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 2148 of 2008
lawyer: Sk. Md. Morshed, Advocate instructed by Mr. Mohammad Nawab Alt Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner
parties:
Md. Jahangir Alam ----- Plaintiff-Appellant-Petitioner
Vs.
The Deputy Director, Regional Directorate of Government Accommodation and others ----- Principal-Defendants-Opposite parties
full_judgment:
B.K. Das J.:- This petition by the plaintiff for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 15.10.2008 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in F.M.A. No. 302 of 2008 summarily dismissing the appeal upon affirming order dated 5.6.2008 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Second Court, Sadar Chittagong in Miscellaneous Case No. 4 of 2008. 

 3. The plaintiffs case in short is that the plaintiff being a government servant applied for accommodation of the government house and accordingly the Deputy Commissioner and the chairman of the Government Accommodation Allotment Board on 10.7.1993 allotted house No. F/6, Nasirabad in District Chittagong and since then the plaintiff has been residing in the said allotted house with his Family. The son and daughter of the plain-tiff have been studying in different institutions at Chittagong town and for such purpose the accommodation of the plaintiff is necessary but without issuing any show cause notice or without giving any opportunity to the plaintiff of being heard, the defendants cancelled the allotment of the aforesaid house by the impugned orders. The suit was transferred to the court of the learned Assistant Judge, Mirsarai, Sadar, Chittagong and renumbered as Other Suit No. 75 of 2006. 

 4. The defendants contested the suit by filing a written statement contending, inter alia, that the plaintiff joined the service on 9.7.1975 and was posted at Hathazari Upazilla Land Office on transfer from the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chittagong and due to his transfer, the allotment was cancelled with effect from 8.9.1995 after giving the plaintiff two months time from the date of his transfer as per rule 15(C) of the Accommodation Rule, 1982 and the plaintiff was given notice more than once to vacate the quarter but the plaintiff without vacating quarter filed the misconceived suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved thereby the plaintiff preferred Other Appeal No. 186 of 2007 before the learned District Judge, Chittagong. The learned Additional District Judge, Second Court, Chittagong fixed 22.5.2008 for hearing the appeal. On the said date, the learned Advocate for the plaintiff filed an application for adjournment but did not move the same when the appeal was taken up for hearing and in such facts the learned Additional District Judge, Chittagong dismissed the appeal for default on 22.2.2008. The plaintiff then filed an application under Order 41 Rule 19(A) of the Code of Civil Procedure before the Second Court of the Additional District Judge, Chittagong upon which Miscellaneous Case No. 4 of 2008 was started. The Second Court of the Additional District Judge, Chittagong by his judgment and order dated 5.6.2008 summarily rejected the said Miscellaneous case on the ground that the case was not entertain able.
